_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking your saved search for new jobs…

annotations.title: New jobs for a saved search

description: The jobs that reached BirJob since this saved search was last checked and match it, newest first, up to 10, each with its birjob.com URL. Marks the search as checked now, so a later call no longer lists these jobs as new. Use this when the user asks what is new for a search they saved. Do not use for a search that is not saved (new_since). Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

alert_id.description: The id from create_job_alert or get_job_alerts.

name: get_new_matches

last_checked.description: ISO 8601. get_new_matches answers what reached BirJob after it.

deadline.description: Application deadline, YYYY-MM-DD. Not read for this list, so always null here; get_job has it.

employment_type.description: Null when the posting does not say.

last_seen.description: ISO time BirJob last saw the posting live at its source.

posted.description: YYYY-MM-DD the source published it, else the day BirJob first saw it.

salary.description: As the board prints it; ₼ is manat (AZN), a month unless it says otherwise.

salary_currency.description: ISO code. AZN where an Azerbaijani posting states no currency, as the board reads it; null when unknown.

salary_max.description: Upper figure as stated. Null when the posting does not say.

salary_min.description: Lower figure as stated. Null when the posting does not say.

salary_period.description: As stated; null when not stated (the board reads that as a month).

seniority.description: The stated career level. Not read for this list, so always null here; get_job has it.

work_format.description: Null when the posting does not say.

more.description: More new jobs than these: the rest are on the alert's search_url.

since.description: ISO 8601. These jobs reached BirJob after it.

title: New jobs for a saved search
